findings.description: Directory entry identity "Bo Ji Professor" is a name/rank concatenation in the page markup; the person is Bo Ji (Professor).

Benjamin Knapp: ECE courtesy entry carries only an administrative title ("Executive Director, ICAT"); no captured source establishes a professorial rank, so excluded as academic_professional. Reclassify to courtesy if an official source shows a professorial appointment.

"Yi Shi Research Associate Professor" (courtesy section) is a name/title concatenation and very likely the same person as the Adjunct Faculty entry "Yi Shi"; both are excluded, so the possible duplicate does not affect counts.
Qiang Li (li.html) is absent from the captured faculty.html listings but appears in the 2026-27 VT ECE catalog Professors list; included as regular.

Enumerated faculty.html alphabetical (99 profile links) plus research-area listings (adds Baumann, Yu; dhillon/mili links without .html), Emeritus, Research, Adjunct and Courtesy text sections; li.html added from catalog. Matches expected_primary_profile_urls.

Tarun Cousik appears both as a profile record and as a Research Faculty directory entry; Daniel Weimer appears in both Emeritus and Research Faculty sections (single record, emeritus). All duplicates are excluded categories.
